allow: Bash(python3 -c " import sys, json for line in sys.stdin: line = line.strip\(\) if not line: continue try: obj = json.loads\(line\) role = obj.get\('role',''\) content = obj.get\('content',''\) if isinstance\(content, list\): for block in content: if isinstance\(block, dict\) and block.get\('type'\) == 'text': text = block.get\('text',''\) if len\(text\) > 100: print\(f'[{role}] {text[:500]}'\) print\('---'\) elif isinstance\(content, str\) and len\(content\) > 100: print\(f'[{role}] {content[:500]}'\) print\('---'\) except: pass ")
